from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,hashlib,sys,re
from tide_lang.workbench import project,render
from tide_lang.program import compile_source
root=Path.cwd(); w=Path(sys.argv[1]); results={}
# Workbench snapshots omit examples and imports. Source text, including literal escape spellings, is otherwise preserved.
def visible(s):
 return '\n\n'.join(b for b in re.split(r'\n[ \t]*\n',s) if b.strip() and b.split()[0] not in ('example','use'))
def check(name,src,mods):
 defs,_=compile_source(src,mods)
 expected={k:render(d.body,True) for k,d in defs.items() if not d.rule}
 packet='\n\n'.join(visible(s) for s in [src,*mods.values()])
 p=subprocess.run([root/'tide','forms'],input=packet,text=True,capture_output=True)
 if p.returncode:
  results[name]={'count':len(expected),'failure':p.stderr.strip()};return
 rows=[r.split('\t',1) for r in p.stdout.splitlines()]
 assert len(rows)==len(dict(rows)) and dict(rows)==expected,(name,[(k,x,expected.get(k)) for k,x in rows if expected.get(k)!=x][:1])
 results[name]={'count':len(rows),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.stdout.encode()).hexdigest()}
for f in [*sorted((root/'apps').glob('*.tide')),*sorted((root/'native').glob('*.tide')),*sorted((root/'native/bootstrap').glob('*.tide')),*sorted((root/'workbench').glob('*.tide'))]:
 s,m=project(f);check(str(f.relative_to(root)),s,m)
project_text='''variant Mode
a b

record Box
low:i
mode:{Mode}

rule tally x:i > i
state last:i=0
else -> last=set x
out last

f m:{Mode} > i
match m b 1 a 0 end

guard q:i > ?i
catch E_DATA (need (nil ?i) "bad" q) why (input_line why)

choose v:i > *i
let boxed make Box low v mode tag Mode b
let xs list i 000002 01 -02
if (=placeholder) xs scan tally xs

g text:t > t
concat text "a\\t\\n\\u00e9 \\" ( \\\\ ) "

recover > b
catch E_DATA fail "bad" error has_reason error "bad"

missing > i
catch E_DATA fail "bad" error raise error

sub s:t > ?i
text_rfind s "/" (text_len s)
'''.replace('=placeholder','eq (f (get mode boxed)) 1')
check('syntax',project_text,{})
check('adjacent', 'main > t\nconcat"ab""cd"\n',{})
check('unicode', 'main > t\n"Grüße"\n',{})
print(json.dumps(results,ensure_ascii=False))
(w/'differential.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
root=/home/ativaro/Documents/tide
b=/var/tmp/tide-batch-WBrQ70sP
mkdir -p "$b/release-clean"
args=(--ro-bind "$b/snapshots" /samples --unshare-all --die-with-parent --new-session --clearenv --setenv PATH /usr/bin --setenv LC_ALL C --setenv HOME /tmp
   --dir /usr --dir /usr/bin --ro-bind /usr/include /usr/include --ro-bind /usr/lib /usr/lib
   --symlink lib /usr/lib64 --symlink usr/bin /bin --symlink usr/lib /lib --symlink usr/lib /lib64
   --dev /dev --proc /proc --tmpfs /tmp --dir /work
   --ro-bind "$root/Makefile" /work/Makefile --ro-bind "$root/tide" /work/tide --ro-bind "$root/native" /work/native
   --ro-bind "$root/apps" /work/apps --bind "$b/release-clean" /work/build --chdir /work)
args+=(--tmpfs /usr/lib/gconv)
for p in /usr/lib/python*; do [[ -d $p ]] && args+=(--tmpfs "$p"); done
for p in /usr/lib/libpython*; do [[ ! -L $p ]] && args+=(--ro-bind /dev/null "$p"); done
for op in sh g++ as ld cat chmod cmp sha256sum xz xxd mv make mktemp rm mkdir env realpath dirname uname sort date install ln; do
    args+=(--ro-bind "$(realpath "/usr/bin/$op")" "/usr/bin/$op")
done
exec bwrap "${args[@]}" /bin/sh -eu -c '
  if command -v python || command -v python3 || test -e /work/reference-tide; then exit 2; fi
  before=$(date +%s%N)
  ./tide forms < /samples/jury.tide > /work/build/first.tsv
  after=$(date +%s%N)
  echo "first_ns=$((after-before))"
  for n in jury depot nano invaders unicode; do
    ./tide forms < /samples/$n.tide > /work/build/$n.tsv
    LC_ALL=C sort /work/build/$n.tsv > /work/build/$n.sorted
    cmp /samples/$n.expected /work/build/$n.sorted
    echo "$n matched"
  done
  make -s -j2 CXX=g++ check-native native
  for cmd in check test run play context hole trace edit fmt describe lock build forms; do ./tide "$cmd" --help > "/work/build/help-$cmd"; test -s "/work/build/help-$cmd"; done
  ./tide --help > /work/build/help-tide
  echo "14 CLI help topics"
  make -s install PREFIX="/usr/local" DESTDIR=/work/build/prefix
  installed=/work/build/prefix/usr/local/bin/tide
  "$installed" --version
  "$installed" build /work/apps/balance.tide /work/build/saldo
  /work/build/saldo
  test ! -e /work/build/prefix/usr/local/lib/tide/reference-tide
  for pair in balance/balance heating/degree_hours cartons/carton_balance heat/simulate pump/simulate light/simulate; do app=${pair%/*}; fn=${pair#*/}; for entry in main "$fn"; do ./tide build "apps/$app.tide" "/work/build/$app-$entry" "$entry"; done; done
  cd /work/build; sha256sum -c /samples/images.sha256; ./light-simulate true false false; ./balance-main
'
